title: The weight of a cone current is homogeneous of degree n (parent step 3, first half)
statement: Let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be a cone, i.e. η_{0,λ#}C = C for every λ > 0 (IsConeCurrent C), and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ n) representing C, with weight μ = θH^n⌞M (R.measure). Then for every λ > 0 and every Borel set A ⊆ ℝ^P, μ(λA) = λ^n μ(A), where λA = {λa : a ∈ A}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsConeCurrent C → R.Represents C → ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure ((fun x => lam • x) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ n) * R.measure A
